roadmap.title: Hall of Doors and Lost Cemetery
roadmap.description: Start the Umbrella run before swinging any other weapon, then gather the forest spirits in the Grove of Spirits.

roadmap.title: Estate of the Urn Witch, Ceramic Manor and Furnace
roadmap.description: Pass the metal detector with a spirit, open the secret garden, and beat the Urn Witch with a fire attack on her pot.

roadmap.title: Overgrown Ruins, Mushroom Dungeon and Flooded Fortress
roadmap.description: Beat the Frog King with a bomb, then upgrade the Fire and Bomb abilities in the Lost Cemetery area.

roadmap.title: Stranded Sailor to the Old Watchtowers
roadmap.description: Free Grunt, take Jefferson's soup, hear Barb's song, then finish the Hookshot and Arrow upgrades and the weapon set.

roadmap.title: The Last Lord and the ending
roadmap.description: Spend your souls in the shop, then beat the Last Lord.

roadmap.title: Post-game night cleanup and true ending
roadmap.description: Ring the bell for night, then finish shinies, shrines, seeds, owls, Jefferson and the seven tablets.

achievements.summary: Beat the game by defeating the Last Lord and finishing the story.

steps.text: Play through the story and beat the @enemy{Last Lord}.

achievements.description: Beat the game only ever using an umbrella as your melee weapon
achievements.summary: Beat the game using only the Discarded Umbrella for melee attacks.

guide.context: Swinging any other melee weapon, even once and even without hitting anything, ends the run. Check the weapon screen: a red background on the Umbrella means you are still eligible.

steps.text: Before swinging the starting sword, go to the @loc{Hall of Doors} office area. Go left, up the staircase on the left, and take the @item{Discarded Umbrella} leaning on a lamp post.
Equip the Umbrella and never swing another melee weapon for the rest of the game.
Spend your souls on Magic first. Use arrows and spells until your magic runs out, then swing the Umbrella to refill it.
Beat the @enemy{Last Lord}. The Umbrella deals half damage, so fights take longer.

achievements.description: Feed the Frog King an explosive treat
achievements.summary: Throw a bomb into the Frog King's mouth during his second phase.

guide.context: You need the Bomb spell, which you get in the @loc{Mushroom Dungeon}.

steps.text: Fight the @enemy{Frog King} in the @loc{Flooded Fortress} until he grows into his large form.
In the second phase, wait for him to jump off the arena into the water and tilt the arena up.
When he starts sucking in air, throw a bomb into his open mouth with the Bomb spell.

achievements.summary: Set the Urn Witch's pot on fire with a fire attack.

guide.context: You need the Fire spell, which you get in the @loc{Estate of the Urn Witch}.

steps.text: In the second phase of the @enemy{Witch of Urns} fight, she hops around inside her pot.
When she falls over and fires projectiles in a circle, hit the pot lid with a fire attack. The fire also stuns her.

achievements.summary: Listen to Barb's whole song in the Stranded Sailor.

guide.context: Barb follows you through @loc{Castle Lockstone} and the @loc{Camp of the Free Crows}.

steps.text: Beat the third Giant.
Return to the @loc{Stranded Sailor} and talk to @npc{Barb}. When she offers to sing, choose "Yes". The achievement unlocks when the song ends.

achievements.summary: Free Grunt from his cell, then talk to him again in the Stranded Sailor.

guide.context: You need the Bomb spell from the @loc{Mushroom Dungeon}.

steps.text: Go back to the start of the @loc{Mushroom Dungeon}. Bomb the breakable wall to free @npc{Grunt} from his cell and talk to him.

Find @npc{Grunt} next to the @loc{Hall of Doors} door in the @loc{Stranded Sailor} and talk to him again. The achievement unlocks during the conversation. He may also stand in the @loc{Overgrown Ruins}; talk to him there instead.

achievements.description: Max out any of the 4 stats
achievements.summary: Buy all 5 upgrades for any one of the four stats.

steps.text: At the big crow by the Soul Vault in the @loc{Hall of Doors} office area, buy all 5 upgrades of one stat: Strength, Dexterity, Haste or Magic. The levels cost 400, 600, 800, 1000 and 1500.

achievements.summary: Buy 12 stat upgrades in total.

steps.text: At the big crow by the Soul Vault in the @loc{Hall of Doors}, buy any 12 stat upgrades.

achievements.summary: Collect all 24 shiny things.

guide.context: Some need all your spells. A few can only be taken after you beat the game.

collectibles.name: Undying Blossom
collectibles.method: Walk toward the building; the camera spins and you enter.

collectibles.name: Incense
collectibles.method: From the summit, jump down on the southwest side and climb onto the coffin lid.

collectibles.name: Old Compass
collectibles.method: Take the south exit once you reach the higher ledge. It lies on the floor.

collectibles.method: Hookshot across the water to find it on the other side.

collectibles.name: Old Engagement Ring
collectibles.method: Climb to the rafters and take it from a shelf.

collectibles.method: Light the brazier in the hallway off to the side. A ladder appears up to the rafters; cross them to reach it. Its back shows the urn order for Plot Head.

collectibles.name: Sludge-Filled Urn
collectibles.method: Push through the bushes onto the hidden path, climb the tower and Hookshot across. Follow the pipes and poles to a spot under a platform.

collectibles.name: Rusty Garden Trowel
collectibles.method: Open the garden with the urn puzzle, then take it.

collectibles.name: Makeshift Soul Key
collectibles.method: Hookshot across to the pole, then go down the stairs to the south.

collectibles.name: Magical Forest Horn
collectibles.method: Take it from open ground. You need it to reach the Mushroom Dungeon.

collectibles.method: Hookshot across the pole and keep hooking until you can drop to its ledge.

collectibles.name: Corrupted Antler

collectibles.method: In the next room, smash the low wall, unlock the gate with the green key, and check beneath the bridge.

collectibles.name: Giant Arrowhead
collectibles.method: After beating the Frog King, climb the ladder at the back of his area and take it from the corner.

collectibles.name: Ancient Door Scale Model
collectibles.method: Once you have Fire, burn the braziers to unlock the gate.

collectibles.name: Modern Door Scale Model
collectibles.method: Hookshot to the pole on the small island and follow the islands to the end.

collectibles.name: Surveillance Device
collectibles.method: Bomb the breakable wall and take it.

collectibles.name: Rusty Belltower Key
collectibles.method: Pick it up after beating the Last Lord.
collectibles.note: Only available after you beat the game.

collectibles.name: Captain's Log
collectibles.location: Hole in the cliff side near the stairs
collectibles.method: Go down the stairs, turn around and enter the hole to a small area.

collectibles.name: Grunt's Old Mask
collectibles.location: By the Hall of Doors door
collectibles.method: Free Grunt in the Mushroom Dungeon, then talk to him here for the mask.

collectibles.name: Ink-Covered Teddy Bear

collectibles.note: You can only get it at night after beating the game.

collectibles.name: Ancient Crown
collectibles.location: Room north of the main hall
collectibles.method: Drop down the pipe, then turn right at the first chance and follow the pipes to the crown.

collectibles.name: Death's Contract
collectibles.method: Fall through the grate in a statue room and follow the hidden corridor.

collectibles.name: Shiny Medallion
collectibles.method: Break the wall behind the lift and enter the cave.

collectibles.name: Mysterious Locket
collectibles.method: Smash the ice beside the lair and climb to the ledge. The door opens at night.
collectibles.note: You can only get it at night after beating the game.

achievements.summary: Collect all 5 melee weapons.

guide.context: You start with the Reaper's Sword, so you need 4 more. Collecting them is enough; you do not have to swing them.

steps.text: Discarded Umbrella: in the @loc{Hall of Doors}, go left of the office area and up the left staircase. It leans on a lamp post.
Rogue Daggers: in the @loc{Estate of the Urn Witch}, behind a locked gate next to the @loc{Ceramic Manor} entrance. First walk east, then loop back to reach the gate.

Thunder Hammer: in the @loc{Overgrown Ruins}, pull the lever that opens the other @loc{Mushroom Dungeon} entrance. Go through the gate and two rooms, break the crates around the hole and drop onto the platform with the hammer.
Reaper's Great Sword: behind a locked gate on the @loc{Stranded Sailor}'s western docks. Find and press 4 hidden switches first. Each one is behind a wall you open with the Bomb spell.
Switch 1: bomb the wall under the long stairs behind Jefferson's boat.
Switch 2: from switch 1 go up the stairs and bomb the wall opposite the big stone head.
Switch 3: go down the wooden stairs, left over the wooden bridge, and bomb the first wall after the bridge.
Switch 4: climb the stone stairway behind the tower building after breaking the ice crystals, and bomb the wall below the gargoyle.
Cross the wooden bridge from the @loc{Hall of Doors} door, take the left bridge, Hookshot across, pull the lever that unlocks the gate, and take the sword.

achievements.summary: Pray at all 16 shrines.

guide.context: There are 8 vitality and 8 magic shrines. Four shrines of one kind give one upgrade.

collectibles.name: Vitality Shrine 1
collectibles.method: Take the lift down, circle behind the building, go down the ladders and into the cave.

collectibles.name: Vitality Shrine 3
collectibles.location: North walkway from the Reaper Door
collectibles.method: With the Hookshot, hook to the walkway north of the Reaper Door, follow the broken bridge and drop down.

collectibles.name: Magic Shrine 4
collectibles.location: Before the cave to the Stranded Sailor
collectibles.method: Drop down the ladder, break the wall and beat the Giant Knight. Take the west exit and climb the ladders.

collectibles.name: Magic Shrine 1
collectibles.method: Push into the bush at the center of the hedges, then continue north through more bushes.

collectibles.name: Vitality Shrine 4
collectibles.method: Light all the fires so a bridge rises to a small island. Cross it and go down the ladder.

collectibles.name: Magic Shrine 2
collectibles.method: Look at the floor reflections to see jars that are not in the room. Hit those invisible jars to open the door.

collectibles.name: Vitality Shrine 5
collectibles.method: Use the northeast bull lift, then take the ladder north and walk west along the pipes.

collectibles.name: Magic Shrine 3
collectibles.method: Drop over the edge, then walk north after the camera pans.

collectibles.name: Vitality Shrine 2
collectibles.method: Break the low wall, stomp down into the pipe and follow it out onto an eastern ledge. The shrine is in the cave there.

collectibles.name: Magic Shrine 6
collectibles.method: Hookshot over the water, hit the button with an arrow, and survive the enemy waves, which end with the Poison Knight. Climb the vine, then take the stairs north.

collectibles.name: Vitality Shrine 6
collectibles.method: Bomb the breakable wall in the corner. In the next room, light 3 fires to open the gate.

collectibles.name: Magic Shrine 7
collectibles.method: Walk the north walkway and fire an arrow through the arch at the distant button. Follow the new tiles north.

collectibles.name: Magic Shrine 5
collectibles.method: Go up the stairs and behind the building, drop by the gargoyle, drop again, and stomp into the pipe. Follow it to the shrine.

collectibles.name: Vitality Shrine 7
collectibles.method: Hookshot north across the docks, beat all the enemies and climb the ladders.

collectibles.name: Magic Shrine 8
collectibles.method: Light the brazier in the west statue room and leave south. Hookshot into the alcove and pull the hidden lever to open the west gate.

collectibles.name: Vitality Shrine 8
collectibles.method: Take the west path and Hookshot across the gaps. Cross the ice, shooting buttons and running onto pillars when they lower.

achievements.description: Take a midnight stroll with Jefferson
achievements.summary: Carry Jefferson on your back at night after beating the game.

guide.context: You can only do this after beating the game.

steps.text: Pick up the @item{Rusty Belltower Key} the Last Lord drops in the @loc{Hall of Doors} lobby.
In the @loc{Lost Cemetery}, go to the belltower by the entrance to the @loc{Estate of the Urn Witch}. Unlock the gate, climb up and hit the bell with your weapon to make it night.
At night in the @loc{Stranded Sailor}, go to the dock and Hookshot to the platform. Beat the @enemy{Giant Knight}, climb the ladder and take the @item{Ink-Covered Teddy Bear}.
Bring the Teddy Bear to @npc{Jefferson} in the big ship building and talk to him. He jumps on your back.

achievements.summary: Collect all 50 Life Seeds and plant each one in a pot.

guide.context: Each seed must also be planted in a pot. Pots are in the same areas, and 2 of them are in the secret garden of the Estate of the Urn Witch. After you beat the game, doors in the Hall of Doors glow red when that level has an unplanted pot. With the Rusty Garden Trowel, your inventory glows blue at night in a region with a seed left. Pothead in his secret garden at night hints at which areas still have empty pots.

achievements.description: Have a gang of 10+ forest spirits follow you
achievements.summary: Have 10 or more forest spirits following you at once.

steps.text: In the @loc{Grove of Spirits}, walk up close to the little green forest spirits and they start following you.
Lead them to the gate of the first boss. After the boss, round up the new spirits and lead them back to that gate, where the first group waits.
Alternative: once you have the Hookshot, return, grab the hidden item and the spirits beside it, then collect the remaining ones. You do not need to fight the boss again.

achievements.summary: Open the secret garden behind the urn puzzle in the Estate of the Urn Witch.

guide.context: The correct order is shown on the reverse side of the Old Photograph, a shiny thing in the @loc{Ceramic Manor}. See the Ooh Shiny! list for where to find it.

steps.text: In the west of the @loc{Estate of the Urn Witch}, find the chessboard of urns. Break 5 urns in the order shown on the reverse of the @item{Old Photograph}.
If you break the wrong urns, wait a few seconds or break 5 urns to reset the board.
Walk through the opened passage to the other side and take the @item{Rusty Garden Trowel}.

achievements.summary: Reach 100% completion on a save file.

guide.context: In the @loc{Hall of Doors}, a glowing level door means that level is not finished. Your save file shows the percentage.

steps.text: Finish all of these: plant all 50 Life Seeds, pray at all 16 shrines, collect all 24 shiny things, upgrade all four abilities, and collect all 5 weapons.
Meet the 3 owls and collect all 7 tablets for the true ending.
Once every shiny thing is collected, go at night to the @loc{Lost Cemetery} and beat the @enemy{Grave Digger}.

achievements.summary: Accept the soup offered by Jefferson in the Stranded Sailor.

steps.text: Enter the big ship building in the @loc{Stranded Sailor}, talk to @npc{Jefferson}, and choose "Yes".

achievements.description: Trigger the metal detector without detecting a threat
achievements.summary: Walk through the Hall of Doors metal detector without it detecting a threat.

steps.text: Once you are about as far as the @loc{Ceramic Manor}, find the forest spirit sitting on a bench in the @loc{Hall of Doors}. Make it follow you.
Go to the far south end of the map, where the game begins, and walk through the metal detector.
Walking through with the Umbrella equipped also works.

achievements.summary: Meet all 3 owls at night after beating the game.

guide.context: The bell must be rung first to make it night: pick up the @item{Rusty Belltower Key} in the @loc{Hall of Doors} lobby and hit the bell in the @loc{Lost Cemetery}.

steps.text: @loc{Estate of the Urn Witch}: find the owl on the bridge outside, a little to the right of the manor entrance.
@loc{Overgrown Ruins}: find the owl above the abandoned forest settlement.
@loc{Old Watchtowers}: pass the icy path with the targeting lasers. The owl is at the end, by a lever.

achievements.summary: Upgrade the Fire ability.

guide.context: You need the Fire spell from the @loc{Estate of the Urn Witch}.

steps.text: Find the building with the bird cage elevator. It sits between the @loc{Lost Cemetery} and the @loc{Estate of the Urn Witch}.
Leave the elevator room and take the other exit, guarded by 2 flaming guardians. Burn the cobweb doorway with a fire attack.
Go through the mini boss door and beat the mini boss to get the upgrade.

achievements.summary: Upgrade the Bomb ability.

guide.context: You need the Bomb spell from the @loc{Mushroom Dungeon}.

steps.text: In the @loc{Lost Cemetery}, go to the east side past the sign pointing to the @loc{Overgrown Ruins}, below the long bridge.
Bomb the hidden entrance, enter the arena and beat the mini boss to get the upgrade.

achievements.summary: Upgrade the Hookshot ability.

steps.text: Inside the cave you pass through on the way from the @loc{Stranded Sailor} back to the @loc{Lost Cemetery}, Hookshot to the small island and pull the lever, then Hookshot back.
Enter the opened gate with 2 green guardians and beat the mini boss to get the upgrade.

achievements.summary: Upgrade the Arrow ability.

guide.context: You need the Fire, Bomb and Hookshot spells to reach this area.

steps.text: In the @loc{Lost Cemetery}, enter the tower to the left of the @loc{Hall of Doors} door.
Beat the many enemies and light the braziers, then beat the mini boss to get the upgrade.

achievements.summary: Place all 7 tablets on the wall in the Camp of the Free Crows to unlock the true ending.

guide.context: You can only do this after beating the game. The bell must be rung first to make it night, and it must stay night for the tablets. Hit the bell as described in the A Stroll with Jefferson guide.

steps.text: Pick up the @item{Rusty Belltower Key} in the @loc{Hall of Doors} lobby and ring the bell in the @loc{Lost Cemetery} to make it night.

Tablet 1: in the @loc{Lost Cemetery} at night, lead all 7 pink lost ghosts to the statues near them. Hit a ghost with your weapon to steer it. When all are placed, a large door in the south opens with the tablet.
Tablet 2: meet the 3 owls. Each one gives a fragment.
Tablet 3: plant all 50 Life Seeds. A door opens in the secret garden of the @loc{Estate of the Urn Witch}.
Tablet 4: in the @loc{Overgrown Ruins}, go south from the @loc{Hall of Doors} door past the gondola area. Open the chest and beat 4 waves of enemies.

Tablet 5: with the Teddy Bear, talk to @npc{Jefferson}. He rides your back, and you cannot use the Reaper Doors. Walk through the @loc{Lost Cemetery}, take the gondola to the @loc{Overgrown Ruins}, and go through the @loc{Mushroom Dungeon} to the @loc{Flooded Fortress}. Follow the glowing tiles to the shrine and pray.
Tablet 6: in the @loc{Old Watchtowers}, light all 6 braziers with Fire. Go through the door that opens in the northeast.
Tablet 7: with the Mysterious Locket, open the Mausoleum in the @loc{Lost Cemetery} at night and beat the @enemy{Grave Digger}.
Return to the @loc{Camp of the Free Crows}, then place all 7 tablets on the wall at the northeast end. Walk down the path that opens to see the true ending.
